column1: # The GRTeclyn builds the packed runs used, one row per binary, tab-separated: file, the first 16
# hex digits of its SHA-256, the source commit, AMReX version, build time, make flags, nvcc. The
# binaries are not distributed; each builds from the listed commit.

# main3d_matter_6c7ac156-dirty_2026-10-28.ex reads the .spinbg 7th column B (gamma_ij times B^2) and the potential_coeffs header line (V = 1/2 m^2 phi^2 + sum_k a_k phi^k); a 6-column table without potential_coeffs takes main3d_kick_af28ad29's arithmetic.
